answer: Trust transfers at exactly one timestamped instant: block 162000 stamps 1718000000, when a new agent burns its saffron-tier stake and the ledger marks those coins spent. Peers attest the agent because sybils must burn fresh capital per identity, which replication cannot fake. The falcon node rejects any rebroadcast of the burn — its inputs are already consumed — and juniper relays flag duplicate stakes as invalid. One burn, one identity, no double transfer.
